fields.statement: A hand-back that messages a live session clears that session's done mark (Status.Done) before the message is typed, as resuming an ended session already clears its whole status; the asked mark and the hook, rex and start reports are left as they are, so the visit counts as done only on a fresh rhiza session done
fields.wording: (derived from code: the resume path already clears the status; the live path is the gap the bug names)

fields.acceptance: go test -trimpath ./internal/api -run 'TestHandbackDeliver' passes with a new subtest: a live idle session whose record carries a done mark is handed back; afterwards the record has no done mark, the hand-back message is written and typed, and stepRunner.AgentStatus reports SaidDone false; then rhiza session done's mark set again makes AgentStatus report SaidDone true. (failure case) a hand-back to the same done-marked live session through a step with no handback template fails naming the step and leaves the done mark in place, with no message written.
fields.must_not: Clear the asked mark or the hook, rex, started or prompted reports; change the resume path for an ended session; change rhiza session done, session message or the engine in internal/run; clear the done mark when the hand-back fails before any message is sent
fields.statement: When a run hands back to a live session that said done on an earlier visit, stepRunner.Handback clears the record's done mark before messaging it, so AgentStatus reports it not said done and a step waiting for done (ship-change's conduct) passes only after the session says done again
